reading.body:
This facility is listed in Aroostook County, Maine, but the operator is not published and could not be identified through available search. The coordinates point to a location on or near the Loring Job Corps Center, a federal training campus on the grounds of the former Loring Air Force Base. No power capacity is published for this facility.

Maine has three mapped data center facilities on record, none with published power specifications. This facility ranks first among them only by absence of any competing published figure, which means it is tied at zero with all others in the state. No power data exists to estimate rack count, accelerator hosting capacity, or grid impact.

Without an identified operator, published power capacity, or confirmation that active data center infrastructure exists at this location, this facility cannot be assessed for relevance to AI scaling. Resolution would require identifying the operator and obtaining facility specifications from a published source.
